name: Deathguard Dillinger
summary: At Brill's edge, Deathguard Dillinger watches the town and guides newly arrived Forsaken. He also sends recruits against the Scourge remnants threatening the nearby farms and mills.

sections.title: Sentinel of Brill
sections.body: Deathguard Dillinger guards Brill and guides those arriving from Deathknell. At the town entrance, he points newly awakened undead toward the inn, town hall, and local trainers. They must learn their way through a changed life under the Dark Lady's rule.

sections.title: Securing the Borderlands
sections.body: Deathguard Dillinger sends capable recruits to clear mindless Scourge from nearby farms and mills. They cull rotting ghouls and reclaim infested facilities, building a safer border around Brill so the fledgling Forsaken settlements can endure the undead threat.

sections.title: Containing Mindless Horrors
sections.body: Ulag the Cleaver remains sealed in a mausoleum north of Brill. When the Scourge swept through Tirisfal, the Forsaken captured Ulag, a Scourge agent with a free mind who remained enthralled to the Lich King. Every attempt to break that hold failed, so Dillinger sends a proven warrior to lift the seal and destroy Ulag.

faq.q: Where can I find Deathguard Dillinger?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger watches the path into Brill, on the outskirts of the town in central Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What is the role of the Deathguard?
faq.answer: The Deathguard is the Forsaken's standing army and constabulary. It guards settlements such as Brill and the Undercity from the Scourge, the Scarlet Crusade, and other regional threats.

faq.q: What tasks does Deathguard Dillinger offer?
faq.answer: Dillinger sends recruits to slay mindless Scourge in the surrounding fields and mills, reclaim local infrastructure, and face dangerous threats such as Ulag the Cleaver.
Yes. Dillinger can direct you to essential services, profession trainers, and class mentors throughout Brill.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken fighting other undead near Brill?
faq.answer: The mindless undead in Tirisfal remain under the Scourge and the Lich King's control. The Forsaken broke free of that control and must destroy these feral remnants to protect their territory.
Ulag the Cleaver is a dangerous Scourge horror tied to tombs near Brill. Dillinger sends Forsaken recruits to summon and destroy Ulag, keeping the surrounding area safe.

angles.text: As a newly freed Forsaken arriving from Deathknell, you may meet Dillinger as your first military authority. He directs you toward training and your first duties in Sylvanas's service.
As a Horde ally, you see the Forsaken's struggle to secure a foothold in northern Lordaeron and the mindless Scourge threatening Brill.
As an aspiring Forsaken warrior, you may work with Dillinger against the ghouls and skeletal horrors prowling Brill's outskirts.
